name: G42 (Group 42 Holding Ltd, Abu Dhabi AI group)
note: Controlling shareholder on record is Royal Group, Sheikh Tahnoon bin Zayed's private holding (claim g42-royal-group-control: 'Royal Group is the majority shareholder of Group 42 Holding Ltd', 2022 SEC 13D). 2026 reporting still describes G42 as controlled by Sheikh Tahnoon. Abu Dhabi's state fund Mubadala holds a minority stake and its chief executive sits on the G42 board (claims g42-mubadala-minority-stake, g42-board-abu-dhabi-officials). G42 launched Analog (claim analog-g42-venture).
